turn1.explanation: The unit fires most strongly on tokens that spell bird names (swan, owl, finch, kestrel, duck, sparrow, falcon, flamingo, heron), whatever the word means in context: surnames, acronyms, idioms, band names and code identifiers all count. Separately, it fires moderately on abbreviated month names in dates (Sep, Oct., Nov., Aug., Feb., Sept.).
turn1.evidence: The bird trigger is purely lexical: every top example is a bird word, including non-bird uses such as 'Yvik Swan' and 'M. Heron' (surnames), the SWAN MRI acronym, 'lame duck', 'green swan', 'Run-Kestrel' in code, 'Robert Falcon Scott' and 'The Flamingos'. All eight mid-range examples (activation 5-7) are abbreviated months inside dates, which have no evident link to birds.
